title: Ottawa Boat Cruise Paul's Boat Line
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Only wheelchair accessible on the Hull Marina on Gatineau side
policies: Please note- there is no rescheduling
Please note - Our tickets our non-refundable.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Our Ottawa River tour offers the finest views along the Ottawa River. This 1 1/2 hour tour is the most thorough tour available on the water. Departures from the Hull Marina in Jacques Cartier Park, and the Ottawa Dock at the foot of the Ottawa Locks. Both tours have live bilingual commentaries.
